title: RPG Inventory
description:
```
Inventory (weight 23.5/50.0)
 [1] Iron Sword       x1   7.0kg    dmg 12
 [2] Health Potion    x5   2.5kg    heals 25
 [3] Gold Coin        x120 0.0kg
> use 2   > drop 1   > sort weight   > stack
```
requirements: `class Item` (name, weight, value, nested `enum class Category`, stack size)
`class Inventory` enforcing a max weight invariant
`add` merges stacks; `remove`, `use`, sorting by any field (lambdas)
`operator[]` to access by slot; `operator<<` for display
